lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, with the largest and most distinct centroids located in the upper-mid section posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like distribution of anchor nodes where the spots are centered within the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running parallel to the dorsal midline, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity pixels on the upper edge to low-intensity shadow pixels on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller, high-luminance blobs that are significantly reduced in diameter compared to the primary flank constellation.
